mapper.select: SELECT f.feedback_id AS feedbackId, f.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.name AS userName, f.content AS content, f.created_at AS createdAt, f.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.feedback_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE is_deleted = 0
